note: UI overhaul lane W1: the small round count badges that sit on the top bar buttons (decisions, operations, contracts). Four badges of exactly the same size and shape, each a flat round boss of dark blackened iron with a calm, even, slightly lighter centre where a white number will be printed, and a thick bright coloured enamel ring around it; they differ only in the colour of the ring, so a number stays readable on every one. Match the walnut, bronze and enamel of the attached top bar icon sheet.
